content: Yesu Betlehem taoŋgo fukeya.

Jon Mitimeso ŋiji fukeko damaŋ oo Sisa-kiŋ Ogastus iŋoji Rom sitio goku moreŋine moreŋine siŋaŋ yabeya. Siŋaŋ yaberu takis fuŋgaru ruanimiŋ ore gawmande mimiti ruame kaeine kaeine sosowo yoŋoji tumaŋgabi kequraŋ (sensus ŋi) yoŋoji tinayaŋuŋ papiago quraŋgaru burugabuŋ.
Buru gio oi damaŋ fuŋfuŋgaine babuŋ. Babuŋ, damaŋ oo ŋi tinaine Kwirinius iŋoji Siria prowinsre gawana goku siŋaŋ yabeya.
Ogastusji mimiti ruame ŋiŋigo sosowo poreru roperu tinayaŋuŋ buruo quraŋganimiŋ ore yoŋoyaŋunde fufuke kae qoruyaŋuŋ so rabuŋ.

Galili prowinsre taoŋ tinaine Nazaret oo ŋi tinaine Josef goya. Iŋore apa oi kiŋ Deiwid. Kiŋ Deiwidre taoŋ tinaine Betlehem oi Judia prowinsgo peya. Ore eru Josefji Nazaret bokeru roperu rakaru Betlehem raya.
Raiŋgo miko damaŋ oo ŋigo biŋeine tinaine Maria oi kuaineke goya. Goko oi moko ogako tinayakuŋ quraŋganimiŋ ore moko rabu.
Raru Betlehem ropebire Mariare made roro damanji mai gaya.
Mai gako tumoqoqo pepe pigo roperu ore maŋgo sawaine mo so bofukebu. Ore eru kaneŋ bulmakao pigo roperu ŋebu. Ŋeku oo moru madeine roru kambanji komoŋ garu bulmakao juago ruame rakaru peya. Oŋu.
Lama siŋaŋ yoŋoji Sombuŋ mimerereŋ ŋone yabebuŋ.
Betlehem taoŋ moreŋ oo ŋi goineji ubu so moreŋ rondiŋine oo raru lama kubuyaŋuŋ siŋaŋ yaberu gobuŋ.
Oŋu gobi ubu oo Ofonde mimerereŋ moji maŋfuŋyaŋuŋgo fuke yareya. Fuke yareme Ofonde kuririquraŋineji rore yaberu tamaeko sombuyaŋuŋ maneru gburugburu yabeya.
Gburugburu yabeyayoŋ, Sombuŋ mimererenji yajiya, “Kaje ruaniŋ! Nonji jeri Biŋe soguine ŋiŋigo sosowo yoŋore baru warego, oi barariŋga ŋarebemiŋ. Ore eru gburugburu so ŋabeine.
Biŋe oi iŋi: Ŋoŋore Munaŋqoqo Rauŋaŋunji muŋambe yoo fukega. Iŋoji kiŋ Deiwidre taoŋgo fukeru Ofoŋ tinaine Kristo fukega.
Buŋo ore mogeine oi iŋi: Ŋoŋo raru made gorubeine kambanji komoŋ garu bulmakao juago ruabi pega, oi bofukenimiŋ.”
Mimererenji oŋu miko oo akoŋ mimerereŋ kubu soguineji Sombuŋgone fukeru iŋoke qotureru Anuture mimiteŋ kiki keku iŋi mibuŋ,

content.text: “Anuture tinabiŋe miteŋ gabeneŋ Sombuŋgo paibe ropega.
Iŋoji ŋiŋigo iŋoyoŋunde roosoe yabeya, yoŋore beufi maneru moreŋgo womo eyarega.” Oŋu.

content: Lama siŋaŋ yoŋoji raru Yesu ŋonebuŋ.
Mimerereŋ yoŋoji boke yaberu Sombuŋgo kirieru ropebi lama siŋaŋ yoŋoji yoŋoyaŋekoŋ iŋi mibuŋ, “Ayo, Betlehem oo ya fukeko Ofonji ore buŋoine miko manegobeneŋ, niŋo oi raru ŋonekimiŋ.”
Oŋu miku pipa raru Maria Josef eru made gorubeine bulmakao juago peya, bofukeru ŋonebuŋ.
Ŋoneru dimaku mimererenji madere buŋo miko maneru warebuŋ, oi barariŋga yareru mitaniŋgabuŋ.
Mitaniŋgabi manebuŋ, yoŋoji sosowo popureru waragabuŋ.
Waregabuŋyoŋ, Mariaji buŋo sosowo oi maŋ wombuŋineo ruaru maŋgaru kiperu fuŋine manesuku goya.
Waragabuŋyoŋ, ya sosowo Sombuŋ mimererenji miya ore so fukeya, oi lama siŋaŋ yoŋoji ŋoneru maneru ore eru Anuture jeri kiki keku miteŋ gabuŋ. Miteŋ garu bokeru kirieru rabuŋ. Oŋu.
Made tinaine Yesu mibuŋ.
Yesu fukeko Sonda moakoŋ ore so tariko Anuture moge sakiineo ketigainde damaŋ wareme tinaine Yesu mibuŋ. Sombuŋ mimererenji tina oi bonieru miku oteme damaŋ oo akoŋ maŋgoinere beu maŋgo fukeya. Oŋu.
Yesu ogaru Anuture biŋe ruabuŋ.

Mosesre Kadi buŋoo buŋo iŋi pega, “Ŋigoji koko madeine fuŋfuŋgaine roru una 40 akoineo goko tariko soki yoŋune keririke teru ŋoŋo boji soriŋgo roperu made oi Ofonde jiŋoo ruabi iŋore biŋe fukeiŋ.” Ore eru damaŋ oi ware fukeme Josef Maria yokoji buŋo oi reŋgaru Yesu ogaru Ofonde biŋe fukeiŋ ore Jerusalem ropebu.
Ofonde Kadi buŋoo buŋo iŋi quraŋgabi pega, “Made fuŋfuŋgaine sosowo oi rua yabebi Ofonde biŋe gbagbataeŋine fukenimiŋ.” Yokoji buŋo oi boyobebu.
Oŋuakoŋ Ofonde Kadi buŋoo mimiti buŋo pega ore so kabu me hurua webo yoyoka oi boji riganimi ore Jerusalem sitio roperu rabu.
Damaŋ oo ŋi mo tinaine Simeon Jerusalem goya. Iŋoji maŋ jumuine Anutureo qakatoru maŋkekerisiere kekegbore eme Moro Tiriineji iŋoke dimako Munaŋqoqo Rauineji Israel maŋgo fukeiŋgo odigaru goya.
Odigaru gome Moro Tiriineji buŋo iŋi barariŋga teya, “Go Ofonde Munaŋqoqo Rauine Kristo fukeko bonieru ŋoneru komeminde joiserereŋ manemiŋ.”
Maŋgo mamaineji Mosesre Kadi buŋo boyoberu Yesu ogaru boji soriŋgo ropebu. Ropebire Moro Tiriineji Simeon boburogame damaŋ oo akoŋ oŋuakoŋ soriŋgo ropeya.
Roperu made oi ŋoneru roru koboru Anutu miteŋ garu iŋi miya.
Simeonde jeri kiki
“O Ofoŋ, muŋambe kiŋaŋ ŋigoji soine raru maŋwomoo goku komebemiŋ.
Gore buŋo pega ore so Munaŋqoqo Rauine sorende fukeme oi nakene jiŋoji

content.text: Goji munaŋqoqo giore kadi bomogaru kantri sosowo yoŋore barariŋga yarende oi ŋoneru mane mukunimiŋ.

content: Goji Munaŋqoqo Rauinere tatama yadunde kotu kantri yoŋore

content.text: eru tinabiŋegoji gakere kufufuŋ Israel niŋore botugo oŋuakoŋ sogueiŋ.”

content: Simeonde kajeqouŋ buŋo
Simeonji made iŋore buŋo oŋu miko maŋgo mamaineji maneru qiqu eru waragabu.
Waragabire mifia yareru maŋgoine Maria iŋi ojiya,

content.text: “Mane, Anutuji made yo igodoŋgaru ruako Israel ŋiŋigo boakonji oi ŋadi gaku waki yabeko
Anutu iŋoyoŋe oi ruako moge fukeko kokoineji oi aari maneru mamboiŋ buŋo mitenimiŋ.
Mamboiŋ mitebi maŋ mamaneyaŋuŋ sumuŋine oi oŋu totogo fukeiŋ.
Gakere maŋgoo oŋuakoŋ beusembe fukeko oiji siqo teteine yobu oŋuine maŋgo ketigako qopogaiŋ.” Oŋu.

content: Ana ŋigo iŋore kajeqouŋ buŋo
Jerusalem oo kajeqouŋ ŋigo qoruine mo tinaine Ana goya. Iŋore apa tinaine Aser, mamaine tinaine Fanuel. Ŋigo oiji jeŋoŋineo ŋi roru gome gosa 7 moko gobu.

Gobire ŋoeine komeko koje fukeru go wapeko damaŋ oo gosaine 84 fukeya. Iŋoji damaŋ so boji soriŋgo roperu oi una mo so bokeyayoŋ, ubu una Anuture uqo sowo goku oŋga wosigaru ohoweine baku miteŋ garu goya.
Iŋoji damaŋ oo akoŋ waperu made oi ŋoneru Anutu miteŋ gaya. Anutuji Jerusalem ŋiŋigo dueyaŋuŋ baiŋgo odigaru gobuŋ, sosowo yoŋore made iŋore fuŋne mitaniŋgako manebuŋ. Oŋu.
Yesuke Nazaret kiriebuŋ.
Josef Maria yokoji Ofonji buruine mitigako Kadi buŋoo pega, oi sosowo ebire tariko Galili prowinsgo kirieru taoŋyakuŋ Nazaret oo rabu.
Madeji sogueru pakereru sanaŋgaru maŋgboroŋineji fukeru puseko Anuture yauŋmoririji kefagame goya.
Yesu gosaine 12 tarime boji soriŋgo ropebuŋ.
Yesure maŋgo mamaji gosa so ŋonemaiŋ
kombaŋ damaŋgo Jerusalem sitio roperu raebuŋ.
Oŋu goku Yesu gosaine 12 tariko mosiyaŋuŋ eegobi ore so damaŋine ware fukeme oŋuakoŋ roperu rabuŋ.
Raru goku kombaŋ damaŋ oiji tariko kirieru piyakuŋgo rabu. Rabuyoŋ, made jeŋoŋ Yesuji Jerusalem ŋeko maŋgo mamaineji oi so mane mukubu.
“Iŋoji ŋiŋigo kubu sogo yoŋoke raga,” miku una moakonde so kadi raru daritife eru ogopuyakuŋ yoŋore botugo oŋgaru baabu.
Oŋgaru baabuyoŋ, so bofukeru moke kirieru Jerusalem raru baabu.
Baaru gokabire una yokaomo tariko boji soriŋgo roperu oo bofukebu. Bofukebire ŋi soguine yoŋore botugo ŋeya. Ŋeko qaji tebuŋ, oi maneru weu yareru ŋeya.
Ŋeku Biŋe buŋore fuŋne poretiŋ mane taniŋgaru poretiŋ akoŋ bokirieko sosowo yoŋoji oi maneru waragabuŋ.
Maŋgo mamaineji ŋoneru popureru maŋgoineji ojiya, “Madene, go uruŋure oŋu enotege? Mane, mamagoke niko gore manebu eru oŋgaku baaguku gogobere.”
Oŋu ojime iŋi bokirie yateya, “Ŋoko wamore noŋ baa nugobire? Noŋ nakene Mamare pigo ŋebe sagaga, oi manegobire me mata?”
Oŋu bokirie yateyayoŋ, yokoji buŋo miya, ore fuŋine oi so mane mukubu.
So mane mukubuyoŋ, jibu pakereru yokoke kirieru Nazaret taoŋgo raru maŋgo mamaine miyakuŋ reŋgaru goya. Yesuji buŋo miya, maŋgoineji oi sosowo maneru maŋ wombuŋineo ruaru kiperu sabareya.
Yesuji goku sogueme gosaine ropeko maŋgboroŋine tamaeru saueko Anutuji yauŋmoririine oteme sanaŋgaru ŋiŋigo eru Anutu yoŋore jiŋoo saga yabeya. Oŋu.
